purpose: Deterministic transaction-level sample for independent Etherscan inspection of the three ARep RQ1 datasets.

sampling.method: Stable SHA-256 ordering with one transaction per contract selected first, followed by deterministic fill records.

validation_method.verified_definition: HTTP 200 and exact page matches for transaction hash, block number, Unix timestamp, contract address, buyer address, and seller address.
validation_method.token_identifier: Retained for manual inspection but excluded from automatic status because Etherscan may render token IDs asynchronously or in a different representation.
